compute.reported_as: In most simulations, we utilize a CNN similar to the ResNet in Ref. [42,69] with 16 layers (8 residual blocks), kernel size 3x3, channel number C = 32, and in total around 150K parameters. Among 32 channels, 28 of them are transformed into F~vh with N~ = 14 hidden fermions in the studied spinful system, and the remaining channels are used for the generalized Jastrow factor J(n). The symmetry projection explained in Appendix F is also implemented to improve the accuracy. For simulations in III D, we utilize a GCNN [41] as also described in Appendix F. Unless otherwise specified, the total number of samples in each VMC iteration is fixed at N_s = 16384, and the training takes around 10^4 VMC iterations.
compute.note: Blanket statement for 'most simulations' (all except the stripe-phase runs of Sec. III.D). Parameter count is approximate ('around 150K'); iteration count approximate ('around 10^4'); samples = 16384 per VMC iteration. Optimizer: SR solved with MinSR and SPRING (momentum 0.5). No device or wall-clock is stated for these runs; the only hardware statements are Fig. 3 (forward-pass timing of 10^3 parallel HFPS passes on an A6000 GPU, a benchmark, not a training run) and Table IV (training hours on NVIDIA H100 80GB GPUs for the L x 4 stripe runs only). Software: Quantax (JAX/Equinox), lrux for low-rank updates.
